name: Story Tree
description: Write a story together and choose what happens next.
businessHypothesis: A reader can publish a continuation and share a new entry point. Repeat writing and actual shared-link participation must be measured before assuming demand or revenue.

name: Idea Duel
description: Share two ideas and let people vote for their favorite.
businessHypothesis: Creators may share duels to choose a future activity or idea. Repeat poll creation and incoming votes can indicate demand; advertising revenue remains unverified.

name: Time Capsule
description: Write a letter that stays sealed until a date you choose, then share its link.
features: Letters that open on your chosen date
businessHypothesis: Celebrations and group traditions could create return visits after opening. Link saving and actual return use must be observed; permanent storage and delivery services are not promised.
